prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: original raster illustration for a Japanese agriculture maintenance-tool lesson. Create one single adjustable crescent wrench, full body visible, centered diagonally in a square composition on a solid warm off-white background. Clean colored 2D educational product illustration with crisp contours and simple restrained shading. Steel gray metal with subtle blue highlights. Show the fixed jaw and separate movable jaw, an obvious cylindrical worm adjustment screw immediately beneath the opening, and a clear smooth parallel jaw gap. Use a slight three-quarter angle so the jaw opening and worm screw can both be clearly recognized. The jaws must be smooth flat faces: this is a normal adjustable wrench for nuts and bolts, never a pipe wrench with serrated toothed jaws. The complete handle and head must be visible with ample blank margins, no cropped parts. No text, Japanese characters, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermark, labels, hands, bolts, nuts, action, extra tools, inset panels, border, or decorative objects. Original neutral illustration, no copied photograph.
